label: 打开网页：先要访问令牌（弹令牌框）
js: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('token-modal'); return { ok: !!m && !m.classList.contains('hidden'), detail: (document.getElementById('token-modal-title') || {}).textContent }; })()

label: 错令牌：不放行并提示
js: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('token-modal'); const err = document.getElementById('token-err').textContent.trim(); return { ok: !m.classList.contains('hidden') && err.length > 0, detail: err }; })()

label: 对令牌：连上并列出四个服务
js: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('token-modal'); const rows = document.querySelectorAll('#services-tbody tr').length; return { ok: m.classList.contains('hidden') && rows >= 4, detail: { rows: rows, conn: ((document.getElementById('conn-text') || {}).textContent || '').trim(), hero: (((document.getElementById('hero-title') || {}).textContent || '') + ' ' + ((document.getElementById('hero-count') || {}).textContent || '')).trim() } }; })()

label: 服务状态（API）
js: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/v1/status?summary=1', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + getActiveToken() } }); const j = await r.json(); return j.services.map(s => s.name + '=' + s.state).join(' '); })()

label: 最近的任务（API）
js: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/v1/jobs', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + getActiveToken() } }); const t = await r.text(); return r.status + ' ' + t.slice(0, 700); })()

label: 版本与升级：弹窗打开、停在 rs-server、读出当前版本
js: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('svc-upgrade-modal'); const tab = document.querySelector('#up-svc-tabs .seg-btn.active'); const cur = ['up-cur-path', 'up-cur-ver', 'up-cur-bytes', 'up-cur-time'].map(i => ((document.getElementById(i) || {}).textContent || '').trim()); return { ok: !m.classList.contains('hidden') && !!tab && tab.dataset.svc === 'rs_server', detail: { title: document.getElementById('up-modal-title').textContent.trim(), tab: tab && tab.dataset.svc, cur: cur } }; })()

label: 仅推送暂存：分块传完，服务器上看得到暂存
js: (async () => { const r = await fetch('/v1/services/versions', { headers: { Authorization: 'Bearer ' + getActiveToken() } }); const t = await r.text(); return { ok: r.ok && /"staged":\{"exists":true/.test(t), detail: { progress: ((document.getElementById('up-progress-text') || {}).textContent || '').trim(), pct: ((document.getElementById('up-progress-pct') || {}).textContent || '').trim() } }; })()

label: 任务页
js: (() => { const v = document.getElementById('view-jobs'); return v ? v.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 500) : 'no #view-jobs'; })()

label: 创建站点弹窗（设计库五项）
js: (() => { const m = document.getElementById('site-modal'); const f = ['site-name', 'site-dir', 'site-code', 'site-mdb', 'site-e3d-root'].filter(i => document.getElementById(i)); return { ok: !!m && !m.classList.contains('hidden') && f.length === 5, detail: f.join(',') }; })()

label: 手机宽度不横向溢出
js: (() => ({ ok: document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= document.documentElement.clientWidth + 1, detail: document.documentElement.scrollWidth + ' / ' + document.documentElement.clientWidth }))()
